SELECT
  LEFT(oi.seller_id, 10) AS seller_id,
  COUNT(*) AS order_item_count,
  ROUND(AVG(ABS(DATE_PART('day', CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))))::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_shipping_limit,
  ROUND(MIN(ABS(DATE_PART('day', CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))))::numeric, 2) AS min_days_to_shipping_limit,
  ROUND(MAX(ABS(DATE_PART('day', CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))))::numeric, 2) AS max_days_to_shipping_limit
FROM
  order_items oi
JOIN
  orders o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE
  oi.shipping_limit_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  LEFT(oi.seller_id, 10)
ORDER BY
  order_item_count DESC;
